_comment: Branch-hook splices of kraken_ui.patch.json: each replaces one stock `bsr` (or displaced instruction) with a `bsr` to our code.
tools/gen_manifest.py expands this table into the manifest's splices (replaced in place by name, new ones appended).
Fields: name, addr; expect = the stock bytes there, OR expect_branch = the stock bsr's target (a name from
tools/link/dm32_stock_symbols.ld, written '@stock:name' in the manifest, or a raw 0x address); target = '@blob:symbol' we branch to
(bias = an offset added to it: the IRAM-load-image sites are executed at flash + -0x030afc20); fill = pad bytes; why = the text,
or t = a template from 'templates' ({iram} = addr - bias, plus the hook's own fields as {caller}, {note}).
The Call Log / Radio Settings / Channel Set generator-call sites are not here: they are gen_sites of their hosts in menu_hosts.json.
What each site does and why its registers are free is the reverse-engineering finding; keep it in the why text.

templates.band_check: Freq Unlock: {caller}'s call of frequency_band_range_check_and_status_set(rx, tx) (one of its four stock calls) -> krk_hook_band_check, which runs it and, while unlocked, rewrites 0x3e31b bit 4 (TX on the UHF PA) and bit 5 (TX not allowed) from the wide TX range
templates.parrot_tx: IRAM {iram}: stock `bsr 0x172f8` (copy 27 bytes 0x49b18 -> modem window 0x16000960; r0=0, r1=lrw 0x49b18, r2=27) in the vocoder TX task. {note} The bsr is encoded against the IRAM pc (flash + -0x030afc20), hence the +0x30afc20 on the target. Regs: after it only r5/r6/r11 (callee-saved) are used, r2/r3/r12 are reloaded (docs/parrot-tx.md 2.2, re-checked).
templates.parrot_rx: IRAM {iram}: stock `bsr 0x172cc` (copy 27 bytes modem window -> 0x46b38; r0=r11=0, r1=lrw 0x46b38, r2=27) in the vocoder RX task (prio 15), the only live read site. krk_vf_rx_hook calls it first, then the RX sink. After the site only r4/r8 (callee-saved) are used and r3/r1/r13 are reloaded. +0x30afc20: IRAM pc encoding.

hooks.name: menu_append_hook
hooks.why: br16 0x304a112 ; bkpt -> bsr trampoline (appends category index 10)

hooks.name: menu_append_hook24
hooks.why: idx24 (VFO-mode top list): `lrw r2,[0x3049fec]; ld.b r2,(r2,0)` -> bsr stub that appends index 10 then re-executes both (krk_stubs.S)

hooks.name: txtrim_interp
hooks.why: F6: freq_calibration_apply_all's bsr freq_calibration_interpolate_selected, whose r0 is stored as the PA drive byte (st.b r0,(r5,0x28) next). Wrapper calls it and scales r0; caller uses only r4/r5 after; r15 saved by the prologue.

hooks.name: aprs_bearing_hemisphere
hooks.why: Stock APRS popup bearing/distance ignore N/S/E/W: stub rewrites W/S stack doubles to 360-x before calc/distance (docs/aprs-stock-gaps.md B.6). Displaced `ld.w r2,(sp,0x18); st.w r2,(sp,0)` re-executed in the stub; r15 saved by the caller's push.

hooks.name: lh_call_start
hooks.why: F1: rxvoice_task_entry flag-0x2 block (every accepted voice header). bsr to a no-arg byte read; the caller uses only r0 after it (docs/last-heard-hooks.md).

hooks.name: lh_call_end
hooks.why: F1: same task, flag-0x4 block: bsr modem_control_state_stop (void(void)); after it only r4/r5/r9 (callee-saved) and fresh r0/r1.

hooks.name: lh_alias
hooks.why: F1: event_flags9_dispatch_and_name_encode copies the decoded talker alias with memcpy_bytes_iram(dst, src, 0x20); only r4 (callee-saved) is used after.

hooks.name: aprs_render_hook
hooks.why: render case block of APRS (category 9) in menu_screen_render_entry_variant: `lrw r3,[settings]; ld.b r2,(r3,0x30)` -> bsr krk_aprs_render (installs count/ptr/subtype and the per-mode index list; r0-r3/r12 dead here, r4-r6/r15 saved by the prologue), then aprs_render_tail jumps over the rest of the block to the shared tail 0x0303dd78

hooks.name: aprs_mode_hook
hooks.why: channel_change_apply_dispatcher: `cmpnei r3,0x30` of the DMR-only test that sets [0x40078] bit 0 (APRS active on this channel) -> bsr stub that re-executes it and also accepts nibble 0 (analog FM), leaving the stock `bt clear` at 0x03057aac to act on C (krk_stubs.S krk_hook_aprs_mode)

hooks.name: aprs_tick_hook
hooks.why: ui_periodic_maintenance_task_loop: start of the GPS-fix-or-fixed-position gate (`lrw r2,[0x38c6c]; ld.b r2,(r2,0)`) before `bsr 0x030625bc` (APRS periodic tick) -> bsr krk_hook_aprs_tick, which applies that gate and calls the stock tick on digital channels and runs the AFSK beacon on analog ones; r0-r3 dead here, r15 saved by the prologue

hooks.name: aprs_send_now_hook
hooks.why: manual Upload Beacon (programmable key path 0x03015824): bsr 0x03062510 (stock DMR APRS send, void(void)) -> krk_hook_aprs_send_now: AFSK on an analog channel, the stock send on a digital one; nothing live after it (pop follows)

hooks.name: chan_commit_end_hook
hooks.why: commit_channel_record_dual_vfo @0x030303bc, the single writer of the live channel struct 0x3e1dc (it also stores a per-side copy at 0x3e358 / 0x3e21c, choosing the side by `get_current_mode_state2() == 0 ? selected : loaded`): all of its paths end at the shared epilogue `ld.w r15,(sp,0); addi sp,sp,0x14; rts`. The 4-byte `ld.w r15,(sp,0)` -> bsr krk_commit_end_stub, which runs krk_hook_chan_commit (snapshot of rx/tx/flags8 per side + the side the struct now describes, docs/dual-watch.md) and re-executes the load. r0-r3/r12/r13 are dead at the epilogue; r15 is restored by the stub

hooks.name: maint_tick_hook
hooks.why: ui_periodic_maintenance_task_loop: `bsr 0x03068224` (call_hold_led_debounce_dual_timer_tick, void(void); r0-r3 dead after it) -> krk_hook_maint_tick, which makes the stock call first and then runs the feature ticks (krk_periodic.c: F12 scrambler, F10 Doppler)

hooks.name: bg_tick_hook
hooks.why: F14 RX Monitor. main_ui_background_task_loop (task init, prio 30, one pass per OS tick): the last call of every pass, `bsr 0x030546dc` (ui_tick_prescaler_post, void(void)), then `br32 0x03013a56` to the OSFlagPend. -> krk_hook_bg_tick, which makes the stock call first and then runs the monitor (krk_periodic.c, krk_aprsrx.c krk_mon_tick); returns at once unless the Monitor is switched on

hooks.name: standby_bottom_hook
hooks.why: Standby tags (krk_tags.c, docs/standby-tags.md). standby_screen_refresh_with_statusbar @0x030195cc (push; bsr display_draw_status_bar; bsr standby_screen_refresh; pop), the only path that draws the standby bottom line (boot, Back from a menu, end of a call, popups): `bsr 0x03018e64` (void(void); r0-r3 dead after it, the pop follows) -> krk_hook_standby_bottom, which makes the stock call first and then draws the tags in x 60..199 of rows 290..319

hooks.name: sq_write_hook
hooks.why: F11: hw_register_0x78_write_from_byte_pair (0x0300de78, `movi r0,0x78; or r1,r3; bsr 0x0002c2f4; pop {r15}`) is the single funnel of every stock REG_78H write (channel apply, squelch-menu change, TX end); stock bytes 80 e2 37 f2 = bsr fd6818_reg_write -> bsr krk_hook_sq_write(0x78, word), which passes the write through unchanged (squelch mode Off, digital, level 0) or writes the noise pair instead (docs/noise-squelch.md 6.3); nothing is live after the call but the saved lr that `pop` restores

hooks.name: calllog_item_hook
hooks.why: Call Log item-action compare chain (0x0303cf80): `bt32 0x0303d872` after `cmpnei r3,3` -> bsr krk_calllog_item_stub (C and r3 live: item 3 -> stock 0x0303cfb6, item 4 -> Last Heard, else the tail). The following `br 0x0303cfb6` becomes dead

hooks.name: parrot_tx1
hooks.note: Dead variant ([0x4988a] has no setter), hooked so a future stock path cannot bypass the layer.

hooks.name: parrot_tx2
hooks.note: Dead variant, second phase, hooked for the same reason.

hooks.name: opt_ok_hook
hooks.why: OK (second handler 0x0303a770) at a level-2 screen for a category the chain does not know (id >= 10: KRAKEN): stock sets mode 0x1c (`movi r0,28; movi r1,1; bsr 0x03035ec4`, 8 bytes). -> bsr krk_opt_ok, which commits an option row and shows the stock Setting-is-OK popup, else does the stock set-mode itself. The function is a case of a handler whose prologue saved r4/r15 and whose epilogue (0x0303ab4a) pops them (docs/stock-option-level.md 2.5)

hooks.name: opt_title_hook
hooks.why: title of the level-2 screen (menu_field_value_display_dispatch 0x03038528, case 0x030385c4: category id >= 10 -> `lrw r3,0x030b1458 (empty string); br 0x03038ece` which draws r3 centered in the header) -> bsr krk_title_stub, which loads r3 = krk_opt_title() and jumps to 0x03038ece (docs/stock-option-level.md 2.4)

hooks.name: aprs_opt_ok_hook
hooks.why: stock APRS (category 9) OK handler 0x0304d6c0, last item test `cmpnei r3,7; bt 0x0304d846` (r3 = level-2 item; items 0..6 were matched above and end in the epilogue) -> bsr krk_aprs_ok_stub: item 7 falls through to the stock block at 0x0304d820, items >= 8 (rows we append, docs/aprs-submenu.md) are committed by krk_aprs_opt_ok when they are option rows (docs/stock-option-level.md 2.6)

hooks.name: opt_numtitle_hook
hooks.why: header of the stock text-entry screen (subtype 8, edit flag [0x3e31e] bit 6): `lrw r3,0x030ba280; ldr.w r3,(r3,r12<<2)` (the 'Input ID' string of the language) -> bsr krk_numtitle_stub, which returns r3 = krk_num_title() with r0-r2 kept (docs/stock-option-level.md 3.4)

hooks.name: rs_item_hook
hooks.why: Radio Settings enter chain 0x030431cc: `bt16 0x030432ea; br16 0x030432ac` after `cmpnei r3,3` -> bsr krk_rs_item_stub (C and r3 live: item 3 -> stock 0x030432ac, item 4 -> our row, else the epilogue)

hooks.name: settings_opt_ok_hook
hooks.why: OK *inside* the option level of a row appended to stock Radio Settings. MEASURED 2026-11-03: opening a row and committing a value are different key events in different functions - the open OK runs 0x0303a770 (category-5 edge 0x0303ab38), the committing OK runs 0x0303a57c -> bsr 0x0304e560 -> jump table 0x030b11c4 entry 0 (Radio Settings) = here. Stock here is a pure no-op (`movi r0,35; movi r1,1; bsr 0x03035ec4` = set_mode(0x23,1), 8 bytes) reached by nothing else: the literal 0x0304e5a0 occurs only in its own table slot, and stock Radio Settings rows commit via 0x0304fab4 instead, so no stock behaviour is lost. Breakpoint-confirmed to fire exactly once, only on the committing OK. The frame (0x0304e560) pushes r15 ONLY, so krk_settings_ok_stub saves r4 itself and jumps to the epilogue 0x0304e83a rather than returning

hooks.name: gnss_item_hook
hooks.why: GNSS item-action compare chain (case block 0x0303d2a0): `cmpnei r3,4; bt16 0x0303d872` -> bsr krk_gnss_item_stub, which redoes the compare (item 4 -> stock block 0x0303d4ac, item 5 -> GPS Grid, else the tail). r3 = item here (items 0..3 were diverted above). The GNSS list has NO generator: the render block builds it sequentially from the descriptor count

hooks.name: of_gen_hook
hooks.why: Other Func row generator: menu_option_list_dispatch(21, 0x3e5f8, 0x3e5fa) (body 0x03049c00), the only call with mode 21 -> krk_hook_of_gen, which calls the stock generator and then takes item 4 (VOX Delay, now a VOX child) out of the list: on an analog channel item 11 (CW ID) takes its place, elsewhere the rows after it move up

hooks.name: of_l6_enter_hook
hooks.why: level-6 option init 0x03045fd8 (Settings > Radio Settings > Other Func > row > child): `cmpnei r3,3; bt16 0x03046336` on the level-4 item -> bsr krk_of_l6_enter_stub (r3 = item, lr = 0x03046240 = stock's VOX arm, which reloads r3). The stub returns there for VOX children 0 and 1 and ends at the epilogue 0x03046336 after installing our option level for VOX child 2 and the CW ID children

hooks.name: of_l6_ok_hook
hooks.why: level-6 commit menu_confirm_apply_dispatcher 0x03050de8: `bt32 0x03051686` after `cmpnei r3,3` on the level-4 item -> bsr krk_of_l6_ok_stub (r3 = item, lr = 0x03051032 = stock's VOX arm). Stock treats every non-zero VOX child as Gain Level, so child 2 MUST be taken here or its cursor would be stored as the gain

hooks.name: of_l6_title_hook
hooks.why: level-6 header 0x03038b9e: `cmpnei r3,3; bt16 0x03038eb0` (blank) on the level-4 item -> bsr krk_of_l6_title_stub (r3 = item, lr = 0x03038c36 = stock's VOX lookup, which titles child 2 from the relocated array). The CW ID children get their label; everything else the blank string as before

hooks.name: cs_l5_enter_hook
hooks.why: Channel Set level-5 init 0x03045084 (render 0x0303cb54 -> 0x0304547c, Settings item 1; docs/chanset-submenu.md 8): `cmphsi r2,13; bt16 0x03045478` on r2 = level-3 row - 3, the bound of its 13-entry table 0x030b09e4 (rows 3..15) -> bsr krk_cs_l5_enter_stub: stock rows return to the table jump at 0x03045098 (r2 kept), every other row runs krk_cs_l5_enter (the Burst Voice children: an option level, or the screen) and leaves through the epilogue 0x03045478. The only branch into the pair is the fall-through; r15 is saved by the prologue (push r4-r7, r15)

hooks.name: cs_l5_ok_hook
hooks.why: Channel Set level-5 OK 0x030500b0 (0x03036420 -> 0x03050414, Settings item 1): the last test of its compare chain on r3 = level-3 row, `cmpnei r3,15; bt16 0x0305040e` (reached from `cmpnei r3,13; bt 0x0305031a`) -> bsr krk_cs_l5_ok_stub: row 15 returns into stock's arm at 0x0305031e (it reloads r3), every other row runs krk_cs_l5_ok (commit a Burst Voice child) and leaves through the epilogue 0x0305040e. r15 saved by the prologue (push r4, r15)

hooks.name: cs_l5_title_hook
hooks.why: level-5 header 0x03038994, Channel Set arm 0x03038a7a: `cmpnei r3,15; bt16 0x03038e9c` (blank) on r3 = level-3 row, the only branch to 0x03038e9c (docs/nested-submenu.md 4) -> bsr krk_cs_l5_title_stub: row 15 returns into stock's lookup at 0x03038abc, every other row draws krk_cs_l5_title() through the draw tail 0x03038ece or stock's blank. r15 saved by 0x03038528's prologue (push r4, r15), popped by the tail

hooks.name: vox_sq_read_hook
hooks.why: VOX (krk_vox.c): vfo_display_state_nibble_bits_check @0x0300f2a4 (= stock_rx_active) is the ONLY caller of reg_0xc_bit1_read @0x0300eb44, stock's one read of sq_out. In the VOX engine's sense word (txon|micin|afout) that bit reads 1, so stock lit the RX LED, opened audio (an audible tick per window), latched RX-active ~60 s after a hot phase and dropped the UI to its call screen. Stock bytes ff e3 41 fc = bsr reg_0xc_bit1_read -> bsr krk_vox_sq_read, which returns 0 during a sense window and 150 ms after it, else performs the original read (docs/otherfunc-submenu.md).

hooks.name: band_load_hook
hooks.why: Freq Unlock (krk_band.c, docs/freq-unlock.md): radio_boot_full_init_sequence's call of rf_config_load_from_flash_block2, the only one; it fills the RX/keypad band table 0x38470 -> krk_hook_band_load, which runs it and then, when the unlock record says ON, writes the wide edges. Runs before startup_channel01_frequency_load_and_validate
